whatsappMessage:
Hi Prabhat's Team,

I noticed your dining and hospitality spot has strong 4.3★ reviews near Rajendra Path in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food menu, aur location highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/prabhats

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Prabhat's Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Prabhat's) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

[If checked:] Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu display, and location details near Rajendra Path in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

[If not checked:] No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
